title: Palindrome Permutation Check
statement:
Decide whether the characters of a string can be rearranged to form a palindrome.

Contract
- `text` is non-null and may be empty.
- Count every UTF-16 character exactly as it appears; matching is case-sensitive and spaces or punctuation are ordinary characters.
- Return `true` when at most one character has an odd count, because such a multiset can be placed in the center of a palindrome.
- Return `false` when two or more different characters have odd counts.

Examples
- `canPermutePalindrome("carrace")` returns `true` because it can become `racecar`.
- `canPermutePalindrome("daily")` returns `false`.
- `canPermutePalindrome("aabb c")` returns `false` because both the space and `c` have odd counts.
hints: A palindrome mirrors pairs of equal characters around its center.
Track whether each character currently has an odd or even count; you only need the number of odd-count characters.
Toggle a character's parity as you scan. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) space for a fixed-size character table.
inputSyntax: Input: one string, for example: carrace
